rows.meaning: pay back money or a debt
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when repay means paying back money or a debt.

example.english: I’ll repay you next week when I get paid.
example.traditional: 我下個星期出糧就還錢畀你。
example.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 ceot1 loeng4 zau6 waan4 cin2 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this when effort or an investment produces a worthwhile return.

example.english: This investment is finally starting to repay us; all those late nights were worth it.
example.traditional: 呢項投資終於有回報，之前捱咁多夜都值得。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 tau4 zi1 zung1 jyu1 jau5 wui4 bou3 zi1 cin4 ngaai4 gam3 do1 je6 dou1 zik6 dak1

rows.note: Use this when repaying a favor or returning someone's kindness.

example.english: You helped me last time, so now it’s my turn to repay the favor.
example.traditional: 你上次幫過我，今次到我還人情喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng6 ci3 bong1 gwo3 ngo5 gam1 ci3 dou3 ngo5 waan4 jan4 cing4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when repaying a wrong by retaliating or taking revenge.

example.english: They were bullied and want to repay the wrong by taking revenge.
example.traditional: 佢畀人蝦，諗住報復返轉頭。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 jan4 haa1 nam2 zyu6 bou3 fuk6 faan1 zyun2 tau4
